summary: Today presents a mixed briefing led by a key Delhi High Court ruling on arbitration cost allocations alongside strong Indian retail growth metrics. Market expansions from FMCG e-commerce tripling to Timex and GIVA revenue surges highlight dynamic sector conditions.

bullets.text: The Delhi High Court stayed an arbitral order requiring parties to pay tribunal costs, assessing the scope of Section 31-A of the Arbitration Act.
Timex Group India reported a 47% year-on-year surge in Q2 revenue to a record Rs 359 crore, with PBT rising 57%.
Jewellery brand GIVA raised over $100 million in fresh capital after closing FY26 with Rs 865 crore in total revenue.
E-commerce channels tripled their market share in India's FMCG retail sales over the past two years, according to Nielsen market data.
Indian tech funding hit a 12-month low of $592 million in October as late-stage investment plunged 72%, despite early-stage gains.
